summary.overall_assessment: The prospectus has several critical deficiencies in its Meaningful Investment disclosures. Module C fails on fundamental requirements, as specific reference dates for sophistication figures are absent and the dates provided for the listing application check are non-compliant. Module G fails to disclose the required 12-month average holdings to justify temporary dilution. These issues prevent a full verification of compliance and require significant remediation.
